data.input: frozen P3 atom/bond/junction objects + fixed rooted walk-mass moment cache
data.global33_standardisation: original P3 train-only fit (ad_data norm.json), same for P/M/G/U
data.new_fitted_statistics: train-only: d column mean/std, mu mean/scale per view/scale/channel, log m mean/scale, log1p(deg) mean/scale; none use y or valid

ssl.atom_input_normalisation: none (the frozen SSL/P3 atom encoder consumes the raw 108-D atom_feat directly; verified against the SSL training path)
ssl.note: train-only masked atom/bond reconstruction; no labels; only supervised-training randomness differs across seeds

rooted_measure.graph: undirected simple adjacency A from the frozen P3 bond_index (each physical bond once); B = I + A, unweighted
rooted_measure.root_mass: m_ik = sum_j B^k[i,j]; p_ik(j) = B^k[i,j] / m_ik
rooted_measure.semantics: walk counts with a stay term from I, not shortest paths, not non-backtracking paths, not chemical resonance counts
rooted_measure.endpoint_standardisation: train column mean / max(std, 1e-3); constant columns scale=1
rooted_measure.projection: R_v[204,12] ~ N(0, 1/204) with generator seeds 7301, 7302; u_jv = tanh(standardize(d_j) @ R_v) / sqrt(12)
cached_moments: C3 packed (364, fully symmetric incl. mixed terms)
rooted_measure.storage: float32 after float64 CPU construction and validation
rooted_measure.standardisation: F standardised by the train-root mu mean / max(std, 0.02) per view/scale/channel (F(q=0) == mu exactly); log Z used directly; log m and log1p(deg) standardised by train mean/std with scale floor 1e-3; global33 uses the original P3 train constants

model.name: RMC (rooted moment conditioning)
model.M: rooted moment body with the full third central moment
model.G: identical body/parameters/inputs, C3 block set to zero (same-mean same-covariance Gaussian closure)
model.U: optional control: rooted distribution replaced by the molecule-global uniform distribution at every root/scale, same C3 rule as the selected arm; real log m_ik retained
model.query: q_i = 4 * tanh(Linear_96_to_48(e_i)).reshape(4, 12) / sqrt(12); head 0/1 -> view 0, head 2/3 -> view 1; one query per head, no refinement

initialisation.common: encoders constructed first under torch.manual_seed(seed) exactly as P3NullModel does, then the RMC modules in a fixed order; the SSL atom/bond/junction encoders are loaded afterwards
initialisation.M_G_common_init: one construction recipe; M and G differ only by the use_c3 flag, never by RNG
initialisation.memory_encoder: separate frozen copy of the SSL atom encoder, never in the optimizer

recipe.source: zinc_arch_discovery_v1.ad_train RECIPE_VARIANTS['B'] through the unchanged trainer (nr_v1 trainer)
recipe.selection: argmin(valid_mae), strict <, ties keep earlier epoch

decision.primary_endpoint: T100 = median valid MAE over epochs 501..600
decision.stability: two seeds same direction on T100 plus best/final/per-molecule checks; no magic margin
decision.h1_reference: same-round P (P3NullModel through the same trainer/collate/device)
decision.test_trigger: see PROTOCOL.md section 9; read once only if the frozen U/A threshold fires

non_goals: no new dataset, backbone family or SSL objective
no per-node hidden-state recursion, no trainable structure operator
no row172 removal or row-specific output
no claim that rooted multi-scale statistics as such are new in this repository (R0/R1 already used rooted count features)
no claim that a graph kernel / polynomial attention / moment feature is invented here
no claim of equivalence to GRIT or of GRIT-level performance
